sources.snippet: LFM2.5-2.6B is an on-device agentic model that plans, calls tools, and runs multi-step tasks at 220 tok/s in under 2.5 GB. Open weights on Hugging Face.

sources.snippet: LFM2.5-2.6B Quantization Report LFM2.5-2.6B is a new tiny model by LiquidAI, with benchmarks that put it head to head with much larger models. I've run llama-perplexity on many model GGUF quants, crossed with many KV cache quants, to understand the model's best overall quantization for any given amount of memory.
